subject: Deployment mode & compliance follow-up (HIPAA/BAA, SOC2) - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion - HIPAA & SOC2 follow-up

Alex —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side following the discovery call:

Summary of Acme's requirements we heard today:
- Must support HIPAA-covered data (PHI) and sign a BAA.
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence for security controls and recent pen test summary.
- Prefer data isolation and predictable throughput for peak-hour batch ingest.
- Interested in on-prem options longer term but want a cloud-first pilot.

Deployment options (high level):
1) Hosted API (fastest onboarding) — good for non-PHI or low-sensitivity PII with encryption at rest & in transit; less isolation than Dedicated.
2) Dedicated capacity (recommended initial path) — reserved GPU pools, data isolation, SLA-backed latency/uptime. Meets most procurement expectations for regulated workloads.
3) Private VPC / on-prem — for full network isolation, KMS/HSM integrations, air-gapped possibilities; longer lead time and higher integration work.

What we need from Acme to move forward:
- Confirmation of preferred deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) — you mentioned Dedicated as a preference, can you confirm?
- Your procurement timeline and any internal milestones (security review date, PO target).
- Any specific compliance artifacts beyond SOC2 Type II and pen test (e.g., specific audit requirements, retention specs).

Next steps from Redwood:
- I’m attaching our SOC2 Type II report and a draft BAA for your legal team to review.
- Dylan will follow up with sizing and a technical deep-dive for Dedicated so we can align on capacity and estimated costs.
- Propose a 30-minute follow-up next Wednesday (8/25) to go over procurement next steps and sign-off items.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, BAA_Draft_AcmeHealth.docx

If this matches your notes, we’ll queue up the technical call and share a DocuSign link for the BAA once you confirm.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion - HIPAA & SOC2 follow-up

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few points from our side:
- Acme Health is leaning toward Dedicated capacity for the pilot. We want the isolation and predictable performance for our ingestion windows.
- Procurement will want the BAA and the latest SOC 2 Type II report; legal will review the BAA we receive.
- Timeline: Security review on Sept 10; procurement target to have PO by end of September.
- We are also evaluating the Private VPC option for a later phase; can you share high-level integration steps for KMS and network peering?
- Also would appreciate a short SOW or statement of work and a demo focused on Dedicated throughput.

Can Dylan provide a rough sizing + cost ballpark and an availability window for the technical deep-dive next week?

Appreciate it —
Alex
VP Product, Acme Health
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com | (212) 555-0175
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode discussion - Dedicated sizing & compliance artifacts

Alex —

Quick technical notes and what I can bring to the deep-dive:

Dedicated overview (short):
- Dedicated = dedicated GPU pools reserved for Acme (predictable throughput, isolated tenants).
- Autoscaling/burst options available for spiky workloads; KV-cache and prefix caching to reduce token cost on repeated queries.
- SLA: configurable latency/availability targets; we can discuss exact SLAs in contract.

Sizing ballpark (initial pilot):
- If your workload is ~200 concurrent user sessions with peak burst to ~6k tokens/minute, a 4-GPU pool (A100-class equiv) should handle initial loads with headroom.
- We’ll instrument token/seq length distributions during the pilot and adjust.
- Cost ballpark (pilot): we’ll provide a committed monthly quote — I’ll include a two-tier pricing option (reserved + burst).

Compliance & integration notes:
- SOC 2 Type II report and pen test summary (attached) cover our control environment. We also provide exportable audit logs and request-level tracing for customer audits.
- Private VPC/on-prem: supports customer KMS integration (bring-your-own-key) and VPC peering; integration timeline typically 6–10 weeks depending on networking approvals.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (same artifact Marissa attached).

I can do a 45-minute technical deep-dive on any of these slots next week: Thu 8/20 10:00–11:00 PDT or Fri 8/21 13:00–14:00 PDT. Which works best? I’ll prepare a short SOW draft and preliminary sizing quote before the call.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com
